riskRules: Fund actions must not imply guaranteed settlement or risk-free movement.
permissions: Visible to signed-in trading account users; action handlers decide eligibility.

riskRules: Destructive or high-risk actions must carry explicit copy and tone in the caller.
permissions: Caller controls visibility based on role and account state.

riskRules: Account status must remain visible when selecting an account.
permissions: Signed-in user with trading account access.
dataInputs: TradingAccountCard trailing variant: radio | chevron | currency
qaGate: Account list entry cards reuse TradingAccountCard with chevron trailing variant instead of duplicating the sheet card body
TradingAccountCard radio selected indicator uses registered AppIcon default size without an icon background
TradingAccountCard metadata rows use a 16px flag, 2px horizontal gap, and no vertical row gap
Account switcher uses icon.system.add for the add action
Selection sheet content supports scrolling for long account lists

riskRules: High-risk trading, funding, security, and account actions must expose explicit cancel and confirm paths.
Confirm actions must be registered in modalRegistry with risk level, close behavior, and confirm behavior.
permissions: Caller owns role, account, and entitlement checks before opening the confirmation.
qaGate: No Alert.alert or window.confirm for governed flows

riskRules: Close-position and order mutations must use registered confirmation or feedback flows.
permissions: Trader role plus production account and order entitlement checks.
qaGate: Uses Card, KeyValueList, TradeOrderList, GlobalMenuList, ConfirmActionSheet, and ToastProvider instead of page-local primitives

riskRules: Order direction, quantity, price/range, and P/L or status values must remain visible and text-based for auditability.
permissions: Caller controls account scope, order entitlement, and mutation permissions.
qaGate: Uses TradeDirectionIcon sizeVariant instead of raw icon size
No page-local trading order row loops
TradeOrderList owns the card container and uses layout.cardPaddingX for list content inset

riskRules: Ledger data must remain textual and auditable; charts are supplemental only.
permissions: Trader role plus production account ownership and ledger scope checks.
qaGate: Uses registered DetailRow, KeyValueList, TransactionRow, MiniBarChart, StatusPill, and BottomSheet presets

riskRules: Deposit, withdrawal, and transfer flows must keep fees, FX, eligibility, and recovery feedback visible.
permissions: Trader role plus production KYC, jurisdiction, limit, account, and payout eligibility checks.
qaGate: Uses TextField, SelectField, TradingAccountSwitchSheet, FundActionGrid, TransactionRow, funding feedback toast, and default-tone IconSurface backgrounds for form selector left icons

riskRules: Trading entry must route through order ticket and must not bypass quote/account entitlement checks.
permissions: Trader role plus production quote entitlement and trading account checks.
qaGate: Route screen consumes InstrumentDetailWorkspace instead of rebuilding the skeleton locally
HeaderIconButton uses surface=auto on white/panel header contexts and registered icons only
Buy and sell actions route through the order ticket and do not bypass quote/account entitlement checks
Workspace uses token-bound layout, i18n keys, InstrumentIcon, SegmentedTabs, NativePressable, and TradingTerminalChart

riskRules: Partner upgrade state must not be overstated as approval before approved status.
permissions: Shown according to role and upgrade request status.

riskRules: Screens may orchestrate business actions but must not define reusable uppercase UI in app routes.
permissions: Route and store guards own access rules.

riskRules: Account identity, status, server, and scope must remain visible before market, funding, and trading actions.
permissions: Signed-in trader or partner flows; production must enforce account ownership and entitlement checks.
qaGate: No page-local trading account switcher shells after migration
Uses registered AppIcon keys and i18n copy
Markets, Portfolio, and Funding import the shared context switcher wrapper

riskRules: Modify, delete, and close actions must expose recoverable feedback and registered confirmation when risk level is high.
permissions: Trader role plus production order/account entitlement checks.
qaGate: Uses ConfirmActionSheet for high-risk close/delete flows
Uses TradingOrderActionSheet for grouped position and pending-order action menus
No page-local GlobalMenuList wrapper cards inside order action sheets
No page-local hardcoded high-risk copy after migration
Portfolio detail sheets import the shared sheet body component

riskRules: Financial metrics must keep labels, units, sign, and period context visible.
permissions: Caller controls data scope and masking policy.
qaGate: No repeated page-local KPI grid when MetricCluster can compose it
Uses token-bound spacing and typography roles

riskRules: Charts are supplemental; numeric source values and labels must remain available as text.
permissions: Caller controls instrument/account data access.
qaGate: No page-local SVG chart for reusable financial trends after migration
Route screens do not import react-native-svg for migrated charts

riskRules: Risk status must not be reduced to color-only communication; text label and score are required.
permissions: Caller controls account scope and risk model.
qaGate: Risk visualization includes textual safe/risk labels

riskRules: Partner rebate and conversion copy must avoid income guarantees and must show synthetic/demo status when applicable.
permissions: Trader preview or Partner role; production Partner data scope required.
qaGate: No page-local Partner card clone after migration

riskRules: Reward copy must not imply trading profit or guaranteed outcome.
permissions: Caller controls campaign eligibility and role visibility.
qaGate: Illustration registry edge required if illustration is used

riskRules: Verification status must not imply production approval unless backend KYC approval exists.
permissions: Guest or signed-in contexts; production KYC provider state required.

riskRules: Theme selection is local preference only and must not affect account/risk state.
permissions: Signed-in optional local settings.
qaGate: No page-local preview card clone after migration

riskRules: Local PIN must stay optional unless an explicit locked-state flow requires unlock.
PIN copy must not imply server-side account security coverage.
permissions: Guest or signed-in optional local security flow; production account security checks remain server-owned.
qaGate: UX Gate required for setup/unlock recovery
Copy-table/i18n key required for visible PIN state copy
No forced unlock when local PIN is disabled by default
Locked-state unlock bypass is guarded by pinGateStatus
Runtime screen consumes components/tokens/copy through src/design-public-assets facade

riskRules: Relationship manager entry must not imply guaranteed service response time unless backend SLA exists.
permissions: Caller controls visibility by account and service availability.

riskRules: Quote freshness, market status, Bid/Ask, and current price must remain visible as text.
Charts are decision support only; order entry still routes through the governed order ticket.
Trend, quote exception, and risk states must not be communicated by color only.
permissions: Caller controls instrument visibility and trading entitlement before rendering or opening order flows.
qaGate: All react-native-svg rendering is inside this business component
Toolbar icons come from the local registered AppIcon registry
OHLCV, Bid/Ask, current price, and stale/closed/restricted states are text-labeled
Embedded instrument detail usage may set toolbarMode=compact to keep advanced indicators and drawing tools out of the first screen
Mobile width keeps chart toolbar horizontally scrollable without overflow

riskRules: All non-Partner Trader segments show Workspace, Markets, Trade, Accounts, Discover, and Dynamic Discover Module as primary bottom tabs.
Trader destination pages and production backend entitlement must still enforce KYC, account, trading, funding, account-scope, and high-risk action permissions.
Active Trader users keep account, margin, position, funding-record, and market status as explicit GUI information.
Partner Mode requires role=partner and approved partner entitlement; potential partners stay in Trader Workspace with application, invite, or information entries only.

Workspace Assist is a quiet explain, diagnose, suggest, generate, and summarize entry only; it must not recommend buy/sell direction, automate orders, submit funding/transfer actions, or send client messages.
permissions: Guest or signed-in optional for Workspace shell; production identity, KYC, account, trading, funding, and partner entitlement services must enforce server-side access before live actions.
qaGate: WorkspaceSegment must be resolved in domain/workspace.ts, not page-level conditionals
Bottom tabs must be built from the domain workspace view model and hidden with href:null when not applicable
Workspace components use registered Card, StatusPill, ActionButton, AppIcon, IconSurface, HeaderIconButton, NativePressable, and token-bound layout only
All visible Workspace copy uses i18n keys and public copy-table governance
No large chat UI, high-risk direct execution, profit promise, recommendation language, or feature-grid fallback
